runtime/database#

The native layer under db/sqlite: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under db/sqlite: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Public API#

native object SqliteState#

native object SqliteState

A SQLite connection and its worker thread.

native object SqliteReplyState#

One reply from the worker.

native sqlite_create(path is @byte, read_only is bool, create is bool, foreign_keys is bool, busy_ms is int, journal is string, memory is bool) is SqliteState

A connection to path (or in memory) with these options, not yet open.

native sqlite_connect#

native async sqlite_connect(state is SqliteState) is SqliteReplyState

Opens the connection; the reply says how it went.

native sqlite_execution#

native async sqlite_execution(state is SqliteState, sql is @byte, kinds is @int, values is @@byte) is SqliteReplyState

Runs sql with values of kinds; the reply says how it went. The kind-code path: kinds 0..6 are null, boolean, integer, floating, decimal, text, bytes, and values are their text (bytes as is); std binds with the *_cells natives below.

native sqlite_reply_kinds#
